historical_row.rationale: GroES (Q88DS3) is a 10 kDa Cpn10 beta-barrel (Pfam PF00166, InterPro IPR020818, IPR037124) that works as a heptameric ring capping GroEL; the UniProt record carries no BINDING site, no metal cofactor and no ligand, and the binding and release cycle is driven by the GroEL ATPase rather than by any cofactor of GroES. For a small, structurally saturated and heavily characterized protein of this kind, the absence of any metal site in the reference record is architectural evidence rather than a gap in curation. Rejection retained with a strengthened reason.

supersession.reason: PR #6164 retains uncertainty because positive mycobacterial Cpn10 metal-binding evidence (PMID:11477217 and PMID:11807250) contradicts a family-wide absence premise, while target-site conservation and binding affinity remain unresolved for KT2440 GroES. Absence of an annotated metal site does not establish loss; no target counter-assay was found. The live review therefore uses UNDECIDED without asserting target binding or changing the historical audit outcome.
